tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.effect_spee: Effect animation speed multiplier. Zero freezes effects.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.effect_inte: Effect opacity multiplier. Zero hides effects.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.reduced_mot: Freeze decorative effects and disable tooltip and icon movement, including custom frame overrides.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.effects_beh: Render effects right over the background, behind the text, icon and frame, instead of on top of everything.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.tooltip_lay: Tooltip layout that modifies the tooltip's size and proportions.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.compact_sho: Show Mod Name in Compact Layout
Show the item's mod name on the left of the Compact layout footer, with the rating on the right. Long names are shortened to fit.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.compact_mod: Color of the mod name in the Compact footer, in ARGB format.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.tiered_item: Render a 3D preview of tiered items such as swords and axes on the left side of the tooltip.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.armor_items: Render a 3D preview of armor pieces on the left side of the tooltip.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.global_fram: Texture applied as a frame overlay to every item.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.auto_scroll: After 3 seconds, automatically slowly scrolls tooltips that do not fit on screen. Manual scrolling disables this until the tooltip changes.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.remember_la: Reopens the config screen and the frame editor on the category, entry and section you were last editing. Remembered until the game closes.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.always_show: Always show equipment comparison for comparable items without holding the comparison key.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.max_pinned_: Maximum number of tooltips that can be pinned at the same time. Pinning past the limit replaces the oldest one.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.second_pane: Horizontal offset in pixels for the 3D preview panel. Negative moves it left, while positive moves it right.
Vertical offset in pixels for the 3D preview panel. Negative moves it up, while positive moves it down.

Height in pixels of the 3D preview panel.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.auto_reposi: Move the preview panel to the right when there is not enough room on the left.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.bedrock_cen: Center tooltips that fit on neither side of the cursor and place them above or below it.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.tooltip_pos: Horizontal tooltip offset in pixels. Negative moves it left, while positive moves it right.
Vertical tooltip offset in pixels. Negative moves it up, while positive moves it down.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.tooltip_z_o: Depth (Z) offset of the whole hovered tooltip. Vanilla draws toasts (advancements, recipes, etc.) at 800, so the default keeps the tooltip over them.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.max_tooltip: Maximum tooltip height as a percentage of the screen height (10-100).
Maximum tooltip width as a percentage of the screen width (20-100).
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.divider_lin: Extra padding above the divider line.
Extra padding below the divider line.

tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.default_bac: Default tooltip background color in ARGB format.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.show_toolti: Apply the custom tooltip style even when no item stack is present, such as on JEI category buttons.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.main_panel_: Horizontal padding for the main panel.
Vertical padding for the main panel.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.no_stack_to: Horizontal main-panel padding when no item stack is present.
Vertical main-panel padding when no item stack is present.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.alignment_i: Centers the title and rating over the whole tooltip instead of the space left next to the icon.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.effects.des: Comma-separated decorative effects. Multiple effects can be combined.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.icon_backgr: Icon background color in ARGB format. Use default for the original color of each background type.

tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.show_mod_na: Appends the display name of the mod that added the hovered item to the tooltip.

tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.show_toolti: Draws a shadow behind the tooltip.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.vignettes.d: Gradient vignette layers around the tooltip background, written as shape, position, color, radius and offset tuples.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.icon_appear: Animation used when the icon appears.

tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.tooltip_ani: Replay the appear animation when moving straight from one item to another. Off keeps the tooltip settled while sweeping across slots.
Duration in seconds of the tooltip appear and disappear animation.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.second_pane: Rotation speed multiplier for the tiered item preview.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.divider_lin: Use match_inner_frame_color, match_item_name_color or an ARGB hexadecimal color.
tooltipoverhaul.config.entry.preview_pan: Model rendered in the preview panel.

Background corner style for the preview panel, independent of its border and the main tooltip.

tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.dura: Minimum remaining durability, inclusive (0-100). Only matches damageable items.
Maximum remaining durability, inclusive (0-100). For example 15 matches almost broken items.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.ench: Requires enchantments or no enchantments. Includes enchanted books.
All selected enchantments must be present. Open the catalogue to search by name or ID, including modded enchantments.
Rules on the item's data components, all of which must match. Write a path to require it (minecraft:custom_data.affix), path=value to require a value (minecraft:custom_data.rarity=apotheosis:epic) or path!=value to exclude one. Dots walk into compounds and [0] into lists (minecraft:enchantments.levels.minecraft:sharpness=5). Numbers match regardless of the type suffix, and true/false matches 1b/0b.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.cust: Case-sensitive custom name, ignoring formatting colors. All configured conditions must match.
tooltipoverhaul.config.frames.field.effe: Multiplier for every effect on this frame. Individual effects can override it in the effect editor.
Opacity multiplier. Zero hides the effects.
Draws the effects right over the background, behind the text, icon and frame.
